newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kisan says wins $400 mln Malaysia order.
newsitem.headline: Kisan says wins $400 mln Malaysia order.

text.p: South Korea's Kisan Co Ltd said on Thursday it has won a $400 million first phase Perlis Port Development Project in Malaysia from Pashacorps Sdn Bhd.
Kisan said in a statement the first phase would include construction of roads, port facilities, container terminals and berths.
The construction is expected to take 56 months, the statement said. The ground breaking for the project is scheduled on Friday.
Kisan, a construction affiliate of Kia Motors, said it is likely to achieve its target of winning 380 billion won worth of overseas projects this year.
